Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Manoj - 36 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Shalini - 55 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Ajay - 26 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Anita - 26 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
5. Meenakshi - 25 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Manoj stands in the court. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Manoj, what's the plan today?"

[Manoj sits down on the throne.]

Manoj: "That was such a fun day!"
